BuildingBlockModule.name: Modules.Shipping

ModuleMeta.Name: Shipping Module
ModuleMeta.Description: Provides domain models, calculators, and state machine logic for the shipping subsystem. Manages shipment lifecycle (Pending → Ready → Shipped → terminal), shipping rate selection, zone-based geographic matching, and strategy-pattern shipping cost calculators ported from Spree Ruby SDK. Consumed by the Ordering module during checkout and by admin features for shipment management.
ModuleMeta.StandardsAlignment: Evans DDD; Strategy Pattern; State Machine pattern

Principle.name: Strategy Pattern Calculators
Principle.Description: Shipping cost calculations use the Strategy pattern via IShippingCalculator interface.
Principle.Rationale: Allows runtime selection of calculator strategy (FlatRate, PerItem, FlexiRate, etc.) without coupling to concrete implementations. Mirrors the Ruby SDK's calculator hierarchy.

Principle.name: Sealed Partial Entity Pattern
Principle.Description: Each domain entity is a sealed partial class with one concern per partial file.
Principle.Rationale: Keeps entity definitions small and focused. Concerns (extensions, validation, constants, results, loggers, custom events, webhooks) each live in their own file, following the Ruby concern-to-interface mapping convention.

Principle.name: State Machine Invariants
Principle.Description: Shipment state transitions follow a strict state machine with well-defined preconditions.
Principle.Rationale: Prevents invalid state transitions and ensures data integrity. Transition rules are ported directly from Ruby SDK shipment.rb state machine.

Feature.name: Shipment Lifecycle
Feature.Description: Full state machine for shipments: Pending, Ready, Shipped, Canceled with extensions for Pend, Resume transitions. Supports after-ship, after-cancel, after-resume lifecycle callbacks.
Feature.ApiHighlight: Shipment { State, Ready(), Ship(), Cancel(), Pend(), Resume() }

Feature.name: Shipping Rate Selection
Feature.Description: Select, unselect, and query shipping rates per shipment. Cost-based rate presentation with delivery range metadata.

Feature.name: Shipping Cost Calculators
Feature.Description: Six strategy-pattern calculators ported from Ruby SDK: FlatRate, PerItem, FlatPercentItemTotal, FlexiRate, PriceSack, DigitalDelivery. Each implements IShippingCalculator with Compute(ShipmentContext).

Methods.Method: Flat fee per order with weight and item total bounds
Normal vs. discount rate based on price threshold
Fixed fee only when all items are digital

Feature.name: Zone-Based Matching
Feature.Description: Geographic zones (Country and State kinds) with zone member membership for address-based shipping eligibility. Ported from Ruby SDK Zone model.

Feature.name: Shipping Method Configuration
Feature.Description: Configurable shipping methods with calculator type assignment, tax category association, zone and category linking, tracking URL template, and availability toggles.

Category.name: Shipments
Category.Description: Core shipment entity and state machine operations. Follows sealed partial pattern with concern-per-file.

Abstraction.name: Shipment
Abstraction.Description: Aggregate root for the shipping bounded context. Tracks shipment state, cost, tracking, and relations to order and stock location.
Abstraction.Purpose: Represent a physical shipment of inventory from a stock location to a customer address. Ported from Spree::Shipment Ruby model.
Abstraction.TopUse: Create and manage shipment lifecycle during checkout fulfillment.

Abstraction.name: ShipmentExtensions
Abstraction.Description: Extension methods for Shipment: factory creation, state transitions (Ready, Ship, Cancel), rate selection, and transfer operations.
Abstraction.Purpose: Provide the primary API for mutating shipment state. Each method returns a Result monad for error handling.

Abstraction.name: ShipmentStateMachine
Abstraction.Description: Additional state transitions (Pend, Resume), lifecycle callbacks (AfterShip, AfterCancel, AfterResume), state determination, and query helpers (IsBackordered, IsTracked, IsShippable, GetTaxTotal).
Abstraction.Purpose: Port Ruby SDK state machine logic: pend, resume, determine_state, manifest operations.

Abstraction.name: ShipmentCustomEvents
Abstraction.Description: Publishes custom domain events for shipment lifecycle: shipment.shipped, shipment.canceled, shipment.resumed.
Abstraction.Purpose: Fire domain-level events so other modules (notifications, analytics) can react to shipment changes.

Abstraction.name: ShipmentWebhooks
Abstraction.Description: Webhook dispatch integration point for shipment lifecycle events. Currently a placeholder for external service integration.
Abstraction.Purpose: Notify external systems when shipments transition to shipped state.

Abstraction.name: ShipmentState
Abstraction.Description: Enum defining valid shipment states: Pending, Ready, Shipped, Canceled.
Abstraction.Purpose: Type-safe representation of shipment lifecycle states, mirroring Ruby SDK state machine states.

Abstraction.name: ShipmentValidation
Abstraction.Description: Validates state machine transitions: Pending→Ready, Pending→Canceled, Ready→Shipped, Ready→Canceled.
Abstraction.Purpose: Enforce valid state transitions per Ruby SDK shipment.rb state machine rules.

Category.name: Shipping Rates
Category.Description: Shipping rate entity for cost presentation and selection.

Abstraction.name: ShippingRate
Abstraction.Description: Entity representing a shipping cost option for a shipment. Contains cost, final price, tax breakdown, and selection state.
Abstraction.Purpose: Model a single shipping rate quote associated with a shipment and shipping method.

Abstraction.name: ShippingRateExtensions
Abstraction.Description: Rate creation, selection, unselection, and free-rate detection.
Abstraction.Purpose: Manage rate selection lifecycle within a shipment's set of available rates.

Category.name: Shipping Methods
Category.Description: Shipping method configuration with calculator and zone associations.

Abstraction.name: ShippingMethod
Abstraction.Description: Configurable shipping method entity with calculator type, tracking URL template, and availability settings. Supports many-to-many relationships with shipping categories and zones via join entities.
Abstraction.Purpose: Define a shipping method that can be selected during checkout, with associated calculator strategy.

Abstraction.name: ShippingMethodCategory
Abstraction.Description: Join entity linking ShippingMethod to ShippingCategory. Enables category-based method filtering.
Abstraction.Purpose: Associate shipping methods with eligible shipping categories.

Abstraction.name: ShippingMethodZone
Abstraction.Description: Join entity linking ShippingMethod to Zone. Enables geographic method availability.
Abstraction.Purpose: Associate shipping methods with eligible geographic zones.

Category.name: Shipping Categories
Category.Description: Shipping category classification for method eligibility.

Abstraction.name: ShippingCategory
Abstraction.Description: Soft-deletable aggregate root categorizing products for shipping method eligibility. Supports parameterizable metadata.
Abstraction.Purpose: Classify products into shipping categories to control which shipping methods apply.

Category.name: Zones
Category.Description: Geographic zone definitions for shipping method availability.

Abstraction.name: Zone
Abstraction.Description: Geographic zone (Country or State kind) with polymorphic zone members. Supports address matching for shipping eligibility determination.
Abstraction.Purpose: Define geographic coverage areas for shipping methods. Ported from Ruby Spree::Zone model.

Abstraction.name: ZoneKind
Abstraction.Description: Enum defining zone kinds: Country (collection of countries) and State (collection of states/provinces).
Abstraction.Purpose: Type-safe zone kind classification per Ruby SDK Zone model.

Category.name: Zone Members
Category.Description: Polymorphic join entities linking zones to countries or states.

Abstraction.name: ZoneMember
Abstraction.Description: Polymorphic entity linking a Zone to a zoneable entity (Country or State) via ZoneableId and ZoneableType.
Abstraction.Purpose: Implement the polymorphic zone membership pattern from Ruby SDK Zone model.

Category.name: Calculators
Category.Description: Shipping cost calculator strategy pattern implementations.

Abstraction.name: IShippingCalculator
Abstraction.Description: Strategy interface for all shipping cost calculators. Defines Compute(ShipmentContext) returning nullable decimal.
Abstraction.Purpose: Enable polymorphic calculator selection per shipping method, following the Ruby SDK ShippingCalculator hierarchy.

Abstraction.name: ShippingCalculator
Abstraction.Description: Abstract base class implementing IShippingCalculator with IsAvailable() guard and Total() helper. All concrete shipping calculators inherit from this.
Abstraction.Purpose: Provide shared Total() computation and availability guard for all shipping calculators.

Abstraction.name: ShipmentContext
Abstraction.Description: Value object carrying shipment calculation context: item total, weight, and content items.
Abstraction.Purpose: Encapsulate all inputs needed by shipping calculators to compute a rate.

Abstraction.name: FlatRateShippingCalculator
Abstraction.Description: Flat-rate shipping with optional weight and item total bounds checks. Returns null when bounds are exceeded.
Abstraction.Purpose: Provide fixed-price shipping configurable with eligibility thresholds. Ported from Spree::Calculator::Shipping::FlatRate.

Abstraction.name: PerItemShippingCalculator
Abstraction.Description: Per-item flat rate: cost = amount × total quantity. Ported from Spree::Calculator::Shipping::PerItem.
Abstraction.Purpose: Calculate shipping as a multiple of quantity.

Abstraction.name: FlatPercentItemTotalShippingCalculator
Abstraction.Description: Percentage-based shipping: cost = total × (flat_percent / 100), rounded to 2 decimals. Ported from Spree::Calculator::Shipping::FlatPercentItemTotal.
Abstraction.Purpose: Calculate shipping as a percentage of the item total.

Abstraction.name: FlexiRateShippingCalculator
Abstraction.Description: Tiered per-item shipping: first_item + additional_item × capped quantity. Ported from Spree::Calculator::Shipping::FlexiRate.
Abstraction.Purpose: Provide graduated pricing where the first item costs more than additional items.

Abstraction.name: PriceSackShippingCalculator
Abstraction.Description: Threshold-based pricing: normal amount below minimal threshold, discount amount above. Ported from Spree::Calculator::Shipping::PriceSack.
Abstraction.Purpose: Provide discounted shipping for orders above a price threshold.

Abstraction.name: DigitalDeliveryShippingCalculator
Abstraction.Description: Digital delivery calculator: returns fixed amount but only available when all shipment contents are digital variants. Ported from Spree::Calculator::Shipping::DigitalDelivery.
Abstraction.Purpose: Handle zero-cost or fixed-cost shipping for digital-only shipments.

Mechanism.name: Shipment State Machine
Mechanism.Scope: Core flow control — shipment lifecycle transitions
Mechanism.Description: Shipment state is managed via extension methods (Ready, Ship, Cancel, Pend, Resume) that validate transitions through ShipmentValidation.IsValidTransition before mutation. This pattern mirrors the Ruby state_machine gem but uses C# extension methods with Result monad return values instead of callback-based transitions.

Mechanism.name: Calculator Strategy Pattern
Mechanism.Scope: Shipping cost computation — strategy selection per shipping method
Mechanism.Description: Each shipping method declares a CalculatorType string. At computation time, the appropriate IShippingCalculator implementation is selected and invoked with a ShipmentContext carrying item totals, weights, and content metadata. Calculators return null when their eligibility conditions are not met, signaling "rate not available" to the caller. All six calculators are ported directly from Ruby SDK shipping calculators.

AntiPattern.name: Bypassing State Validation
AntiPattern.Avoid: Directly setting Shipment.State without calling transition methods.
AntiPattern.Impact: Circumvents transition validation, potentially leaving system in inconsistent state.

AntiPattern.name: Hardcoding Calculator Logic
AntiPattern.Avoid: Embedding shipping cost calculation logic outside the calculator strategy classes.
AntiPattern.BetterApproach: Implement IShippingCalculator for new strategies and register via CalculatorType resolution.
AntiPattern.Impact: Makes the system rigid and non-extensible. New calculators cannot be added without modifying core logic.

Scenario.title: Creating and Shipping an Order's Shipment
Scenario.Context: During checkout fulfillment, a shipment must be created, a rate selected, and the shipment shipped.

Benefits.Benefit: Guarantees valid state transitions per Ruby SDK state machine rules.
All operations return Result monad for consistent error handling.

Scenario.title: Using a Calculator Strategy
Scenario.Context: Compute shipping cost using a specific calculator strategy for a given shipping method.

Benefits.Benefit: New calculators can be added without modifying existing ones (Open/Closed principle).

Strategy.title: Calculator Unit Tests
Strategy.Objective: Verify each shipping calculator returns correct cost for given inputs and respects eligibility bounds.

Strategy.title: State Transition Tests
Strategy.Objective: Verify valid and invalid state transitions for Shipment state machine.
